headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawTerminalCorrectedCode_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (hTerm k : ℕ)
  (completionWord : Fin (Math115.PhysicalCompletionWidth.uniformCompletionBits r c U L hTerm) → Bool)
  (correctionWord : Fin k → Bool),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawTerminalCorrectedCode (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑d) hTerm k (List.ofFn completionWord)
      (List.ofFn correctionWord) =
    Option.map (fun X => OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑X)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalBitCorrection r c U L k
        ⟨d, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCompletion r c U L hr hc d hTerm completionWord⟩ correctionWord)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCorrectedTrial_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h k : ℕ)
      (word : Fin (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedWordWidth r c U L h k) → Bool),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCorrectedTrial (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
          (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑start) h k (List.ofFn word) =
        Option.map (fun X => OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑X)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedWord r c U L hr hc start h k word)
